name: OpenClaw Business Auth Broker V1
description: Generic business service authentication broker with per-agent canary gate and global enable/disable switch. Supports client-credentials OAuth2 token acquisition via SecretRef, audience-scoped token cache, and pluggable capability adapters.

globalEnabled.description: Global kill switch. When false, no tools are registered and all agents behave as if the plugin is not installed.

enabledAgentIds.description: Allowlist of agent IDs that may invoke broker tools. Agents not in this list receive a fail-closed error at execution time.

agentClients.description: Per-agent client credential mapping. Each agent ID maps to an OAuth2 client ID and a reference to its client secret.

targets.description: Registered target services. Each target specifies an audience for token issuance and an allowed origin for fetch validation.

capabilities.description: Registered capabilities that adapters implement. Each capability links a business function to a target, required scopes, and HTTP endpoint.
